description: The 2006 code description specifies monitoring, pollution-abatement equipment and emissions rules for forage dryers. It distinguishes dryer type, urban or rural location, an urban population threshold of 50,000, and dates before or after January 2015. It also describes wastewater/runoff restrictions and waste-management requirements. These are source-defined operating constraints for industrial drying facilities. Numerical concentration limits are not present in the metadata and are not invented. The legal body, current amendments and named publisher reuse terms were not inspected. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
